name: Momo_trades
summary: Momo_trades is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that identifies trade opportunities by detecting strong directional price moves. It enters positions when momentum confirms a trend direction and manages exits through a combination of take-profit and stop-loss levels. The EA focuses on capturing momentum bursts in the market using technical indicator confirmations.
summary_zh: Momo_trades是一个基于动量的Expert Advisor，通过检测强势方向性价格走势来识别交易机会。当动量确认趋势方向时入场，并通过止盈和止损组合管理出场。该EA专注于利用技术指标确认来捕捉市场中的动量爆发。
strategy_analysis: Momo_trades策略的核心概念是基于动量突破进行交易，当市场出现强劲的单边动量时入场跟随趋势。入场条件依赖于动量指标的确认信号，通常结合移动平均线方向和动量震荡器的极值判断来决定买卖方向。出场条件包括预设的止盈和止损水平，以及动量衰竭时的平仓信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式，未发现马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。资金管理方面使用止损来控制单笔风险，但缺少最大回撤限制和整体仓位控制机制。策略整体属于典型的趋势动量跟随系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境，在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号导致亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Momo_trades strategy is based on momentum breakout trading, entering positions to follow the trend when the market exhibits strong unilateral momentum. Entry conditions rely on momentum indicator confirmation signals, typically combining moving average direction and momentum oscillator extreme values to determine buy or sell direction. Exit conditions include preset take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as position closing signals when momentum fades. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or account balance-based proportional lot sizing, with no martingale or grid position-adding logic detected. Money management uses stop-losses to control per-trade risk, but lacks maximum drawdown limits and overall position control mechanisms. The strategy is a typical trend momentum following system, suitable for markets with clear trends, but may generate numerous false signals leading to losses in ranging markets.

parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于动量跟随趋势，符合市场趋势运行规律
设有止损和止盈，单笔风险可控，不存在马丁格尔或网格等高风险加仓逻辑
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和周期调整参数适应市场
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on momentum trend following, aligned with market trend movement principles
Stop-loss and take-profit are set, per-trade risk is controllable, and no high-risk martingale or grid position-adding logic exists
High configurability with parameters allowing users to adapt to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生虚假动量信号导致频繁亏损
缺少最大回撤控制和整体仓位限制，在连续亏损时风险敞口较大
未检测点差过滤，在高点差环境下入场可能导致不必要的滑点损失
缺少新K线判断机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Prone to false momentum signals in ranging markets leading to frequent losses
Lacks maximum drawdown control and overall position limits, creating large risk exposure during consecutive losses
No spread filter detected, entries in high-spread environments may cause unnecessary slippage losses
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加新K线判断逻辑，避免同一根K线上重复开仓，提高交易效率
添加点差过滤和波动率过滤，在市场条件不适宜时禁止入场
增加最大回撤限制和每日最大亏损限制，完善资金管理
improvements_en: Add new bar detection logic to prevent duplicate position opening on the same bar, improving trade efficiency
Add spread filter and volatility filter to prohibit entry when market conditions are unfavorable
Add maximum drawdown limit and daily maximum loss limit to improve money management

risk_points: 缺少新K线判断机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
无最大回撤限制，连续亏损时风险敞口无法自动收敛
未设置点差过滤，高点差环境下止损可能被意外触发
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially causing over-trading with duplicate positions on the same bar
No maximum drawdown limit, risk exposure cannot automatically converge during consecutive losses
No spread filter set, stop-losses may be accidentally triggered in high-spread environments
